title: Bug: External Agent $PATH auto-discovery fails for non-built-in and passive agents (v0.5.5)

verdict.rationale: The evidence covers status refactoring, the external agent prototype, attach loosening, and the enable agent-selection flow. None of it mentions deciding that attach/status skip $PATH discovery, that passive agents without hook support be excluded from configure, or that discovery be gated on settings. These gaps look like omissions rather than chosen behaviour.
